description: Finance-specific instantiation of the Dashboard SaaS archetype. Combines dashboard_core structure with finance industry context — personal finance, wealth management, banking, or fintech SaaS.

industry_overrides.tone: authoritative, precise, trustworthy — never casual with money
trust_signals: regulatory compliance badges — FCA, SEC, FDIC
audit trail for all financial actions

visual_language.style: clean, data-dense, precise — numbers are the hero
photography_rules: no photography — pure CSS and data viz only
visual_language.background_treatment: dark or neutral — high contrast for financial data legibility
visual_language.empty_state_style: clean CSS illustration with prompt to connect accounts or add data
visual_language.chart_style: line charts for trends, bar for comparisons, donut for allocation — always labelled

relationships: User owns or belongs to an Organisation
Account belongs to User or Organisation — bank, credit, investment, crypto
Budget belongs to User or Organisation, tracks spending by category
Goal belongs to User — savings target, debt payoff, investment milestone
Report is generated from Transactions and Metrics
Metric is a computed value — net worth, savings rate, burn rate, ROI
Portfolio belongs to User or Organisation, contains investment holdings
Alert belongs to User, fires on threshold breach or unusual activity
Integration connects Account to external financial institution or service
AuditLog records all financial actions by Users

mvp.description: Core financial dashboard — connect accounts, view transactions, track spending, basic budgeting.
primary_flows: Sign up → connect bank account → view dashboard → browse transactions → view spending by category
Set budget → track spending vs budget → receive alert when near limit
View net worth → see assets and liabilities → understand financial position

interaction_patterns: Net worth counter — animates on load, counting up to current value
Budget progress bar — green below 70%, amber 70–90%, red above 90%
Transaction category badge — colour coded per category type
Pending transaction — italic or muted style — clears to normal when posted
Account sync spinner — rotates while refreshing — tick on complete
Amount always right-aligned in transaction list for easy scanning
Unusual transaction flagged with amber indicator in list
Empty accounts state — prominent connect account CTA with security reassurance

interaction_patterns: All MVP interaction patterns
Net worth trend line — hover to see exact value at any point in time
Goal progress — milestone dots on progress bar — celebrate on milestone hit
Portfolio allocation donut — tap segment to highlight and show percentage
Cash flow bar — income bars above zero line, expense bars below
Bill due soon — amber highlight when due within 7 days, red when overdue
Receipt attachment — camera icon on transaction detail — photo uploads inline
Rollover budget — carry-over amount shown in muted text at budget top

scale.description: Enterprise finance platform — multi-entity, approval workflows, compliance, treasury management, and audit.
primary_flows: Multi-entity org — manage finances for multiple companies under one platform
Expense approval workflow — employee submits → manager approves → finance processes → accounting synced
Compliance officer runs audit → exports full transaction log → satisfies regulatory requirement
Treasury manager views cash positions across entities → forecasts liquidity → takes action
Finance admin connects ERP → transactions sync bidirectionally → reconciliation automated
